de1.P3.C5.ghi_chu: Chua chot cach hieu y hoi: loi giai va short_correct dang luu (1,47) tinh the tich phan loi khoan ra (tru + 2 chom cau = pi(8-3 can 3)/6 khoang 1,47 dm3); nhung cau hoi 'khoan rut loi ... duoc mot vat the co the tich V' cung co the hieu la the tich vat con lai sau khi khoan, khi do V = the tich cau - loi = 4pi/3 - 1,47 khoang 2,72 dm3. Can thay chot y hoi (loi lay ra hay vat con lai) truoc khi sua short_correct; entry nay chi bo sung ghi chu, khong doi short_correct.
de1.P3.C5.ly_do: The tich loi khoan ra kiem dung bang 1,47; the tich vat con lai kiem dung bang 2,72; hai cach hieu cho hai dap so khac nhau nen chua doi dap an.
